subtitle: Calendar drafts, review and event advice
description: MacOS developer preview: view a bounded Google agenda, keep event drafts, review changes in the host and discuss a selected event with a read-only assistant. Uses host-managed Google authorization and optional consented app-agent tools; credentials stay in the host. Fresh GitHub-published app identity with separate storage/account grants from the legacy sample. Requires contract 1.8.0 / publisher-github-v1 and compatible connected services. Includes fictional local UI states. Publishing and local UI tests do not validate live Google login, provider writes, model behavior or physical approval. Android Google authorization is unavailable; only macOS is advertised.
release_notes: 0.2.0: fresh app ID and GitHub-attested publishing workflow, with no developer signing key. Previous legacy releases remain immutable; no data/account migration. Current bounded-agenda UI preserved; Glance/chat/deep links now target the fresh ID. Fresh native screenshots and release-specific validation accompany this version; live provider effects remain unverified.
